side_note: Positions are never entered by hand: they are recomputed from the structure, so inserting in the middle never means shifting anything manually.
canvas_aria: GRAFCET canvas. Arrow keys to navigate, {k} to insert, Delete to remove, Enter for properties.
ins_none_bar: Select the convergence or a branch
ins_none_end: End of sequence: nothing can be added here
ins_help: Click an element, or press an arrow key, to place the cursor.
sim_help: click a highlighted transition to fire it.
act_none: No action: the step is a waiting step.
jump_hint: A jump ends the sequence. After a transition it points to a step; after a step it points to a transition.
or_hint: Selection: only one branch is crossed. The conditions must be mutually exclusive.
and_hint: Parallelism: all branches start together and the convergence waits for every branch to finish.
key_move: move the cursor from element to element
key_insert: insert what is possible after the cursor; with Shift, before
no_issue_more: No other issue detected in this GRAFCET.
text_hint: Text equivalent of the diagram, navigable with the keyboard and screen readers.
copy_fail: Copy refused: select the text manually.
import_hint: Paste the JSON of a complete project (replaces the project) or of a single GRAFCET (adds it).
imp_items: A GRAFCET must contain an “items” array.
a_cannot_delete: Cannot delete here: a sequence cannot be left empty. Delete the branch or the divergence instead.
a_renumbered: Steps and transitions renumbered, Xn references updated.
chk_start_or: an OR branch must start with a transition
chk_start_and: an AND branch must start with a step
chk_min_branches: a divergence has at least 2 branches
chk_jump_and: a jump is not allowed inside an AND branch
chk_block_end: a divergence must be followed by an element
chk_or_end: an OR branch ends with a transition
chk_and_end: an AND branch ends with a step
v_dupnum: Step number {n} is used more than once.
v_act_label: Step {n}: an action has no label.
v_act_cond: Step {n}: a conditional action has no condition.
v_step_missing: Transition ({n}): step X{m} does not exist.
v_jump_broken: A jump has lost its target.
v_dead_end: {x} has no successor: the GRAFCET is not closed.
v_unreachable: {x} is unreachable from the initial step.
imp_format: This file is not a GRAFCET Studio project.
wrap_hint: Creates a divergence around the element; the new branch is yours to complete.
unwrap_hint: Replaces the divergence with one of its branches; the others are deleted.
a_wrap_impossible: This element cannot be wrapped here.
a_unwrap_impossible: Not possible: the result would not be a valid GRAFCET.
imp_sfcedit_root: This XML is not an SFCEdit export (expected a “project” element).
rep_unknown_tag: Element “{tag}” is not supported and was ignored.
rep_grafcet_type: Grafcet “{g}” has type “{type}”: imported as a normal GRAFCET.
rep_step_type: Step “{name}” of type “{type}” in “{g}”: imported as a normal step.
rep_step_name: Step name “{name}” in “{g}” is not numeric: a number was assigned.
rep_action_type: Action of type “{type}” in “{g}”: imported as a continuous action.
rep_cycle: “{g}”: circular structure or no starting point, sequences ignored.
rep_jump_target: “{g}”: jump to an empty sequence, ignored.
rep_conv_kind: “{g}”: divergence and convergence of different kinds (AND/OR).
rep_orphan_seq: “{g}”: sequence {n} is not connected to anything and was not imported.
rep_x_jump_mid: “{g}”: a jump targets the middle of a sequence; SFCEdit can only target a sequence start.
rep_x_edge: “{g}”: edges (↑ ↓) are written as plain text in conditions; SFCEdit does not interpret them.
rep_x_timer: “{g}”: timers are written as plain text in conditions.
rep_x_actions: “{g}”: action types (activation, deactivation) are kept in attributes SFCEdit ignores.
rep_x_labels: Step names are kept in an attribute SFCEdit ignores.
v_num_bad: Step identifier “{n}” is invalid: letters, digits and _ only.
imp_zip_not_zip: This file is not a valid ZIP archive.
imp_zip_method: Compressed archive not supported (only GRAFCET Studio archives are).
imp_zip_path: Archive rejected: file path not allowed.
imp_plcopen_root: This XML is not a PLCopen project (expected a “project” element).
imp_plcopen_nosfc: No POU with an SFC body in this PLCopen project.
rep_p_skip_pou: POU “{n}” skipped: its body is not SFC.
rep_p_ident: “{n}” (in “{g}”) is not a valid IEC identifier: it is not declared in the POU interface.
rep_p_cond_action: “{g}”: conditional actions are exported as an ST assignment (variable := condition).
rep_p_empty_cond: “{g}”: transition ({n}) has no receptivity; exported without a condition.
rep_p_edge: “{g}”: edges (↑ ↓) cannot be represented in the ST condition; the edge is omitted.
rep_p_jump_trans: “{g}”: a jump to a transition does not exist in PLCopen (jump not exported).
rep_p_qualifier: “{g}”: action qualifier “{q}” not supported, imported as a continuous action.
rep_p_inline_action: “{g}”: unrecognised action body, kept as text.
rep_p_cond_st: “{g}”: a condition contains ST code that is not a plain Boolean expression; please check.
rep_p_cond_graphic: “{g}”: graphical condition (FBD/LD) not supported, empty receptivity.
rep_p_conv_mixed: “{g}”: the branches of a divergence do not converge at the same point.
rep_p_implicit_div: “{g}”: several successors without an explicit divergence; only the first is kept.
rep_p_no_initial: “{g}”: no initial step declared; the first step without predecessor is used.
rep_p_orphan: “{g}”: elements not connected to the initial step were not imported.
profile_help_grafcet: GRAFCET as a specification language: common checks, plus exclusivity of OR divergences.
profile_help_sfc: SFC for a programmable controller: common checks, plus IEC-compatible jumps, edges and identifiers.
profile_help_plcopen: SFC intended for PLCopen XML export: SFC rules, plus the limits of the export.
v_or_exclusive: OR divergence: exclusivity of transitions ({a}) and ({b}) is not proven; both may fire together.
v_sfc_jump_trans: A jump to a transition does not exist in SFC: a jump targets a step.
v_sfc_edge: Transition ({n}): an edge (↑ ↓) is not a direct SFC condition; an edge detector is needed.
v_sfc_ident: Step {n}: “{v}” is not a valid IEC identifier (unaccented letters, digits and _).
v_plc_cond_action: Step {n}: the conditional action will be exported as an ST assignment.
cited_here: Cited by {n} element of this GRAFCET (highlighted). | Cited by {n} elements of this GRAFCET (highlighted).
cite_title: A receptivity or action in this GRAFCET cites step {n}
